sources.snippet: MULTI-evolve (model-guided, universal, targeted installation of multi-mutants) is an end-to-end framework for protein directed evolution. It trains sequence-to-fitness prediction models, proposes combinatorial multi-mutants, generates MULTI-assembly site-directed mutagenesis oligonucleotides, and supports screening single-mutant candidates through a protein language model zero-shot ensemble ...
